verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration/visa service that holds client case data, with status dashboards and records, so asking whether a client can export that data and leave is a fair question. The evidence pack never documents data export, open formats, or offboarding. "Audit-ready records" is an adjacent claim about record-keeping, not export, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
